title: Your real PC becomes your pirate ship. Hardware Pirates beta playtests are now open!
author: pabe_balteq
selftext:
Your monitors raise Digital Sails. Your keyboard’s keys become your crew. Your RAM powers your ram. Your storage becomes your cargo hold. Your free USB ports become gunports.

Since last week’s update, we’ve added gameplay metrics to understand how players are performing and where they struggle. With Claude Code, we’ve also been able to fix bugs quickly while players are actively playtesting and make targeted balance adjustments for the upcoming demo experience.

The feedback loop is getting much faster: players test, we review the metrics and their feedback, then make changes for the next session.

One curator recently spent about two hours playing and got pretty hooked, which was encouraging to see!

Now we’re inviting more players aboard before the **public demo on December 16**. We’d love your feedback on combat, performance across different PC setups, and what keeps you coming back for another voyage.

**Join our Discord to request a Steam key and share your feedback:**  
[https://discord.gg/BWtUPj2F8](https://discord.gg/BWtUPj2F8)

Recording, streaming and sharing your experience are welcome too!

A wishlist or a share would also help us reach more players 🙂  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5065230/Hardware\_Pirates/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5065230/Hardware_Pirates/)
